text: Volume is not my arming test (R5): day_vol 1.01 is a relative-volume proxy, fill difficulty NOT_SERVED, so I set no volume level and do not arm on one. I stand behind h1_close_above:bar_high on price alone: W close above weekly swing highs 90.36 and 92.49, 1.8% under the 20-wk high, D HH/HL 0.3% through the swing high - a fresh high in an established trend (C5). My check is follow-through (C17): fade_atr_ge:1 (atr_14d 1.83) off the day's high, or a close back under pivot_high, ends it (C7/C20). The ticket should print the volume level as oneil's, not mine.
